section:
Use case: ui-mockup. Edit the supplied 8x social website section concept into a more beautifully STRUCTURED visual comparison. User loves the woman, halftone and stone/orange palette, but rejects raw bullet text. They want the value comparison from the original website expressed with thoughtful UI design, not a plain conventional table. Keep the exact same woman, her facial expression and the photographic halftone identity. This is a concept screenshot,1536x1024.

Maintain continuous warm stone #e9e5dc background, nearblack #151515, vermilion #f34b32. Same restrained top navigation and logo as reference. No new palette or scene. No tabs or hidden content.

New composition:
Top-left generous two-line editorial heading at x64,y145, modern grotesk semibold about70px:
"Why brands are"
"moving budget here."
One small orange terminal dot. Subheading at x68,y330 in21px muted charcoal:
"Three ways to reach people. A different way to build."
Headline occupies the left950px max, not overlapping woman's face.
Woman moves further RIGHT and scales to occupy x1010-1536,y190-1024, with visible face looking toward comparison. Preserve dramatic halftone shoulder dissolving into the page, candid monochrome photography, orange architectural vertical rectangle behind head. Keep face and head complete, clear, large. Illustration has no frame. She is supporting the section, not obstructing UI. Her left edge softly dissolves behind the gap after comparison. No typography overlaps image.

The MAIN CONTENT beneath heading, x64 to1000,y425to910, is a polished comparison composition, all visible at once. NOT a bullet list. NOT a spreadsheet with lots of gridlines. Three carefully designed narrow editorial columns, consistent alignment:
Column1 x64-352, Column2 x380-665, Column3 x705-990. Gap~30px. All3 tops and text baselines align.
8x is expressed as a beautifully proportioned solid nearblack RECTANGULAR PANEL, tiny3px corner radius, matte/no shadow. Its text warm-white, fine orange accents, and a subtle small halftone dot dissolution confined to bottom edge only. Other2 columns sit directly on stone page with no card border, no background box. This deliberate asymmetry establishes priority while preserving a clean minimal page.

Top of column1 at x88,y451 a small orange circle and "8x network" in28px white. Other columns heading black28px: "Influencers" and "Paid ads". Under each title one small descriptive caption in muted tone:
8x "An ongoing creator programme"
Influencers "Creator partnerships"
Paid ads "Media campaigns"

Each column has three structured content groups vertically aligned at y560,665,770. Every group uses a TINY secondary muted label in13px with natural case and main value22px underneath. Each group separated by generous space, NOT horizontal lines. Exact values:

First group label "Content"
8x value "Original creator videos"
Influencers value "Sponsored posts"
Paid ads value "Ad creative"

Second group label "Distribution"
8x value "Creator accounts"
Influencers value "Partner audiences"
Paid ads value "Paid placements"

Third group label "Management"
8x value "Run by 8x"
Influencers value "Creator or agency"
Paid ads value "Media buying"

In each column, include one small precise visual motif between title caption and groups: 8x five little orange/white dots held together by alignment (no connecting lines); Influencers three small carbon dots widely separated; Paidads one small grey dot within a thin outline circle. These are quiet brand identity elements, NOT charts or quantitative metrics. No ratings, ticks or crosses. Avoid falsely saying other channels cannot do management or organic reach.

At bottom of black8xpanel y864 simple text CTA "Build your network ↗" in warmwhite with tinyorange arrow. No other buttons. No bottom footer. Use generous panelpadding24px. All copy fits comfortably and is correctly spelled, modest realistic type sizes.

The result is a genuinely polished visual comparison experience: priority through contrast, grouped facts through spacing, human photography at the right, delicate dot identity. Visually stronger than text bullets, calmer than a dashboard. Compare content types, distribution mechanisms and management models, no invented financial/performance claims. No giant checkbox grid, table rules, matrix lines, pricing amounts, tabs, pills, rainbow, icons toolbar, conventional repetitive equal card grid. No raw paragraph stacks. Keep whole section one continuous surface and crisp realistic website proportions. Avoid over-large headline that squeezes comparison. Render as final premium web design screenshot, no annotations, no storyboard, no browser chrome.
motion:
Use case: ui-mockup.
Generate a precise, beautifully designed MOTION STORYBOARD for the supplied approved 8x social comparison section. The user approved the layout and wants to see the seamless scroll transition AND hover states before implementation. Retain reference typography, woman portrait, orange architectural background accent, stone #e9e5dc canvas, black #151515 and vermilion #f34b32. Do not invent an entirely new page. Output one high-resolution landscape storyboard, ideally2400x1600, legible and polished. Four large screenshot panels in a2x2 grid, generous quiet gutters, each viewport screenshot landscape roughly1100x650. Labels OUTSIDE screenshots. The screenshots are documentation of actual feasible UI states, NOT a website filled with labels or miniature storyboard thumbnails. No device frames or browser chrome.

Top panel labels:
"01 / SCROLL CONTINUES"
subcaption "The same canvas. The next section enters naturally."
"02 / 8x NETWORK — HOVER"
subcaption "The panel darkens. Orange dots gather at the base."
Bottom panel labels:
"03 / INFLUENCERS — HOVER"
subcaption "The same response, with no movement in the layout."
"04 / PAID ADS — HOVER"
subcaption "A quiet lift in depth. A slow breath through the dots."

All screenshot panels keep SAME sticky navbar: serif "8x" and sans "social" left; "The network", "How it works", "For creators", "Let's talk ↗" right. Same stone background throughout. No horizontal section separator lines. No full-screen wipes. No scene changes or page color changes. No tabs, selectors, toggles, hiding text. Allthree comparison columns remain readable in every state, fixed widths, aligned baselines, stable geometry.

Panel01 actual mid-scroll screenshot: at top below nav the lower part of the PREVIOUS approved showcase is visible: two tight rows of equal-size small vertical portrait videos, entirely grayscale except one restrained patch of natural skin tones. The video grid sits on same stone background, outer boundary softly dissolves into halftone dots. Show bottom row / partial grid only, occupying top25% screenshot. Large natural whitespace follows, then the comparison section heading "Why brands are moving budget here." starts below around40%height. On the right the woman's blackwhite head and orange rectangle enter from below as ordinary scrolling content. Upper halves of three comparison columns visible near bottom. Both sections coexist in viewport, physically on the same continuous document. This makes continuity explicit; no scroll pinning, no dramatic morph, no video flying across screen, no hard borders, no giant diagram arrow. Adjacent sections separated only by well-proportioned whitespace.

Panels02,03,04 all show the ENTIRE approved comparison section at same settled scroll position: heading top-left in bold modern sans "Why brands are moving budget here." two lines, subheading "Three ways to reach people. A different way to build." below. Rightmost third is same laughing monochrome woman, naturally dissolving halftone shoulder, orange vertical rectangle behind her. Lefttwo-thirds has THREE narrow comparison columns. Portrait must not overlap columns.
Titles "8x network", "Influencers", "Paid ads".
Each column has SAMEthree small labels: "Content", "Distribution", "Management".
Values for8x: "Original creator videos", "Creator accounts", "Run by 8x".
Values forInfluencers: "Sponsored posts", "Partner audiences", "Creator or agency".
Values forPaidads: "Ad creative", "Paid placements", "Media buying".
Keep small subordinate captions if space permits: "An ongoing creator programme", "Creator partnerships", "Media campaigns".
Keep the CTA "Build your network ↗" in8x column.
No fabricated metrics, comparative ticks/crosses or text implying competitor columns are unavailable.

Panel02: ONLY8x column is hovered, same nearblack panel as supplied image, warmwhite type, small orange accent nearheading. Orange halftone at bottom-right of card is a delicate crescent of ordered dots emerging from loweredge, varying pointsize and gentlycurved precise density. Show mouse cursor over8xtitle. This panel implies a240ms smooth ink fill, and8second low-amplitude dotbreath, not large movingparticles. Othercolumns sit borderless onstone, darktext, no orange field.
Panel03: NOWInfluencers column alone is nearblack withwhitetype andexact same orangehalftone bottom-right treatment.8x returns tostone withblacktype, asdoesPaid. ShowcursoroverInfluencers. Card boundaries never change size, nor textposition. Subtle depth only via restrainedsoftshadow, max2px lift. Portrait staysidentical. Contentneverdisappears.
Panel04: NOWPaid ads alone is nearblack withwhitetype andsameorangebottomhalftone. Other2neutralstone. ShowcursoroverPaidads. Nothing elsemoves.

Visual refinement: actual screenshot panels must be clear, consistent, spacious, credible miniature versions of reference, not overloaded. Halftone motif in cards subtly echoes portrait and precedingvideo edges. Neutral rest state has allcolumns onstone; pointeractivates exactlyone. Thin restrainedsoftshadow onlyhoveredpanel, no glass, no neon, no harshglow, no exaggeratedtilt, no rainbow. No labels insideactualUI aboutanimation. Board backgroundslightlylighterthanpanels, captionscharcoal, elegantdesignsystem presentation. Main purpose show uninterrupted scrolling and three consistent hoverstates. Preserve reference visual identity veryclosely.
